card.name: Adverbs before related, due, or descended
card.fires_on: Adverbs such as directly, inversely, distantly or immediately placed just before a word like related, correlated, proportional, due or descended. It also fires on the word direct in "direct antiglobulin test".

modes.label: Directly before a link
modes.description: The word directly sits before a link word such as due, related or attributable, asking whether one thing causes another.
modes.example: whether they're<< directly>> due to the medications themselves

modes.label: Inversely or distantly
modes.description: An adverb ending is split off and describes how two things are related.

modes.label: Direct as a modifier
modes.description: The word direct is used in a technical term.

card.writes: It suppresses the word direct and its forms, so the model is less likely to repeat direct wording next.
card.plain: It marks adverbs like directly or inversely that describe how two things are related or caused.
